products.name: Cerebras
products.note: Wafer-scale AI compute; inference API; on-prem options; high-performance computing

profile_text.body:
Cerebras is an AI infrastructure company that describes itself as a platform for AI training and inference, built around its wafer-scale compute hardware. The company offers an inference API as well as on-premises deployment options, and its flagship chip, the CS-3, is positioned as a high-speed alternative to conventional GPUs for demanding AI workloads.

The company's commercial partners include OpenAI, GSK, Notion, and LiveKit, each of whom is quoted on the Cerebras site describing use cases ranging from low-latency inference and enterprise search to drug discovery and real-time voice AI. GSK describes running a cancer-drug response prediction model many hundreds of times faster on the Cerebras chip than on a conventional GPU. One partner describes inference throughput of approximately 1,000 tokens per second, and another describes a joint architecture splitting inference workloads across Trainium and the CS-3, connected via EFA, yielding what they characterize as an order of magnitude improvement in speed and performance.

The held facts show Cerebras is tracked under the Chat and General LLMs product category, covering its wafer-scale compute, inference API, and on-premises options. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are noted in the current data.
